findings.title: Registry-driven mixed cart and per-round products
findings.implemented: Three rental slots, all four EX families and three current super permits use stable product IDs and canonical registry prices. Lineup chooses no free art. All product rows and Save/Load/Repeat/Keep/Ready/Facts are semantically owned controls.

findings.title: Last-valid atomic ready/timeout integration
findings.implemented: Canonical PurchasePlanning validates before replacing a cart; invalid edits retain prior IDs. Quoted content hash/price are used at commit; two plans commit together. Popup ownership is isolated per input seat. Timeout has a visible last-valid explanation.
remainingLimitations: Core/App own actual atomicity, remote commit/reveal and settlement; this UI report does not replace their tests.
Session owner added timeout-plan remembering for remote repeat after dev2; final native/network evidence pending.

findings.title: Saved and repeated plans revalidate without stale slot indexes
findings.implemented: Stores up to six mixed stable IDs and optional old total/content hash. Loading re-quotes current content/bank/caps and explains changed totals. Invalid/oversized data is rejected whole; duplicates remain visible to canonical validation. Repeat reprices the prior round and never auto-buys. Legacy ID-only settings remain supported.

findings.title: Confirmed factual previous-round observations
findings.implemented: Previous-round strip/popup exposes revealed opponent kit, super use, actual jump/counter/parry counts and allowed skill awards. Counts make no prediction claim. Local events are actual results; network facts accept only confirmed Add/Confirm and retain original round from stable key. Deduped keys prevent double confirmation counts.
remainingLimitations: New correction specifically excludes cancelled speculative jumps; native rollback/history regression remains to be executed.
Observed jumps are labelled jumps, not inferred jump-ins. Full revealed-kit details are in the owner-controlled Facts popup.

findings.title: Capability HUD and truthful next-shop feedback
findings.implemented: HUD displays exact OwnedEx, SUPER READY/USED/NONE, small static saved bank, actual pending next-shop amount, health/time/score/stun. Rejections distinguish unowned EX, unpurchased super, exhausted super and illegal actor state. SkillAward uses actual allowed Value and NEXT SHOP; practice opportunity is explicit. No startup money/debit/reserve gate or gauge is drawn.
remainingLimitations: Final candidate still needs owned-super READY-to-USED and partial reward native captures; ordinary zero-use/owned-EX state was inspected.

findings.title: Settlement receipt cooperation
findings.implemented: Supplies factual presentation and retained confirmed public history; authoritative complete economy report belongs to Main.EconomyReport and App.RoundEconomyLedger maintained by session owner.
remainingLimitations: The inspected final-result screenshot establishes readable result/rematch UI only, not complete receipt accounting.

findings.title: Input-role conflicts and independent local panels
findings.implemented: Maintains explicit menu ownership, remapping and confirm-release quarantine. Shop rows are semantic rather than guessed geometry. Existing physical/logical-compatible input paths and Start/Escape pause rules are preserved.
remainingLimitations: Software-injected controller events do not certify actual pad hardware, unplug/replug behavior, simultaneous two-player hardware or human usability.

findings.title: Legal separation and stage coverage
findings.implemented: Both complete cel envelopes fit bounded presentation camera without changing Core movement. All stage/object/debug transforms share it. Marist background uses aspect-preserving .75 minimum cover independently of fighter zoom, avoiding exposed stretched sky rows.

findings.title: Untimed catalog and honest practice entry
findings.implemented: Catalog exposes all current runtime nodes, including branches with their owning entry move, and live rental/EX/super products. Full card shows input, replacement, purpose/tradeoff and current device bindings. Practice is an explicit lab kit; no competitive shop timer is paused and no hypothetical move is marked implemented.
remainingLimitations: Session owns actual training controls and trace output. Dev2 explanation wrapping issue was fixed after capture and must be rechecked.
Frame counts are authored startup/active/recovery, not a measured advantage or balance verdict.

preservedAuditScope.note: The historical report retains pre-v2 identity and evidence. This handoff does not relabel it as v2 native proof. Current v2 supersedes its combat-cost/reserve expectations, while camera, event positions, timing, sprite/cel/palette limitations and stage/audio work remain applicable.
remainingArtLimits: Existing fighter sheets remain RGB with runtime chroma key; genuine authored RGBA cleanup has not been achieved or claimed.
Explicit existing cel holds and reuse do not invent missing in-betweens or a newly authored unique animation for every buyable branch.
Mirror palette masks are still heuristic; selected prior native art reviews do not establish every pose-edge at this new candidate.
Actual normal-frame pacing must be measured again on the final v2 export; prior 60FPS measurements are historical.
